Deploying LibraryLab on Heroku

Prerequisites

  • Install Heroku CLI
  • Install Git
  • Sign up for a Heroku account
  • Ensure Java 17, Maven, Node.js, and Angular CLI are installed

Step 1: Prepare the Spring Boot Backend

heroku login
git init
heroku create librarylab-app
heroku addons:create heroku-postgresql:hobby-dev

Configure Database Settings

spring.datasource.url=${JDBC_DATABASE_URL}
spring.datasource.username=${JDBC_DATABASE_USERNAME}
spring.datasource.password=${JDBC_DATABASE_PASSWORD}

mvn clean package
git add .
git commit -m "Deploy Spring Boot to Heroku"
git push heroku main
heroku ps:scale web=1
heroku logs --tail

Step 2: Deploy Angular Frontend to Heroku

cd frontend

Create a server.js file

const express = require("express");
const path = require("path");
const app = express();
app.use(express.static(__dirname + "/dist/librarylab"));
app.get("/*", function (req, res) {
    res.sendFile(path.join(__dirname + "/dist/librarylab/index.html"));
});
app.listen(process.env.PORT || 8080);

npm install express --save

Modify package.json

"scripts": {
    "start": "node server.js",
    "postinstall": "ng build --prod"
}

git add .
git commit -m "Deploy Angular frontend to Heroku"
git push heroku main
heroku open

Your LibraryLab App is Now Live on Heroku! 🚀

You can now access your Spring Boot backend and Angular frontend using the Heroku URLs provided.
